app_info.subtitle: Japan government bid search
app_info.description: JP Bids helps users search and monitor Japanese public-sector procurement notices (government tenders) published on the official Small and Medium Enterprise Agency KKJ portal. Users can search by keyword, project name, organization, prefecture, category, or date range; get a scored, prioritized shortlist of bids worth pursuing; and check a daily digest of newly published notices for a region or category. All data is read-only public government information; the app never submits bids, applications, or any data on the user's behalf.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only queries the public KKJ procurement search API and returns matching notices; it never creates, updates, or deletes anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries an unpredictable, continuously-updated public data set (like a web search) but does not write, publish, or otherwise change any public-facing state; results are returned only to the requesting user.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only search with no delete, overwrite, or irreversible side effects of any kind.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs the same read-only KKJ search as search_bids and scores the results locally in memory; no data is created, updated, or deleted anywhere.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from the same unpredictable public procurement data set as search_bids but does not write or publish anything.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only scoring with no delete, overwrite, or irreversible side effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists recently published KKJ notices for a date window; it only retrieves data and never modifies anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from the public, continuously-updated KKJ notice feed but does not write or publish anything.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only listing with no delete, overwrite, or irreversible side effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches full detail for a single bid by key and returns official links; it never modifies data and never stores attachments server-side.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns links to official public KKJ pages and attachments (external resources) but does not write, publish, or change any public-facing state itself.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only detail lookup with no delete, overwrite, or irreversible side effects.

test_cases.description: Search for bids by keyword and prefecture.
test_cases.user_prompt: 鹿児島県でIT関連の官公需入札を探して。
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a list of matching Kagoshima IT-related procurement notices with organization, prefecture, submission deadline, and a Key for each, plus the official KKJ attribution.

test_cases.description: Search for bids from a specific organization and category.
test_cases.user_prompt: 農林水産省が発注した役務の入札を検索して。
test_cases.expected_output: Returns notices filtered to the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries in the services (役務) category, with the same KKJ attribution shown.

test_cases.description: Rank search results by follow-up priority using preferred keywords.
test_cases.user_prompt: クラウドや保守に関わる入札を、追うべき順にランク付けして。
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a scored, prioritized shortlist (pursue/review/skip) with a short reason for each ranked bid, based on the preferred keywords.

test_cases.description: List recently published notices for a region as a daily check.
test_cases.user_prompt: 東京都で直近7日間に公告された新着の入札を教えて。
test_cases.expected_output: Returns notices published in Tokyo over the last 7 days with a count and the KKJ attribution.

test_cases.description: Get full detail for one bid using the key returned by an earlier search.
test_cases.user_prompt: さっき出てきた最初の案件の詳細と公式ページのリンクを教えて。
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the project name, organization, and Key for the specified bid, plus a link to the official KKJ announcement page (and any attachment links, without storing the files).

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated private-sector job listings.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: 民間企業のエンジニア求人を探して。
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because private-sector job listings are outside its scope, which is limited to public Japanese government procurement notices.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not attempt to submit or apply for a bid on the user's behalf.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: この入札に代わりに応募しておいて。
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app has no write or submission capability; it should explain that it can only search and analyze public bid information, and direct the user to the official KKJ announcement page to apply themselves.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not guess a bid detail without a valid key or prior search context.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: この入札の詳細をもっとください。
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Without a prior search result or an explicit bid key in the conversation, the app should ask the user to search first (or provide a key) rather than calling get_bid_detail with a guessed or empty key.
